memoryReview.evidence: apps/afterhours-arena README and scene inspected; side-view fighter arcade
memoryReview.lesson: Do not repeat the cabinet/fighting stage: use full-bleed circular defense with touch-directed lamp.

memoryReview.evidence: apps/moss-marble config and visual doctrine inspected; physical miniature
memoryReview.lesson: Use charcoal stone night mood and one light cone, not lush putting greens.

memoryReview.evidence: apps/chush art-bible and visual-direction inspected; colorful stamp painting
memoryReview.lesson: Avoid flat multicolored stamp catalog and boxed drawing editor.

references.observation: Solo artists emphasize reusable moving parts, small sprites, few key poses and fixed references.
references.principle: Control per-frame redraw cost; use small pose families.
references.application: 32x32 fixed-origin two-pose creatures with motion conveyed by per-entity timing and contact glow.
references.avoid: Do not borrow character art or claim a community post is a benchmark.

references.observation: Pixel workflows reward small palette, fixed light direction and exact integer cell resolution.
references.application: Single indexed creature atlas with 14 colors and integer dimensions, nearest-neighbor drawing.
references.avoid: Do not copy pixel shapes or palette artwork.

references.observation: Sprites are layered frame timelines with fixed-size cels.
references.principle: Use stable pivots, durations and frame roles.
references.application: Editable Forge row layers record 12 independent poses and durations.
references.avoid: No editor screenshots or imagery reused.

concepts.medium: Indexed 32x32 pixel characters, hand-set SVG heraldic seal, vector glow lighting.
concepts.composition: Full-bleed top-down ruined abbey arena under the right thumb; narrow masonry console above and bell below.
concepts.interaction: Drag finger to turn destructive cone; strike a single accessible bell with cooldown.
concepts.motion: Anticipated lamp rotation, contact sparks, radius shockwave, recoil and spatial fade.
concepts.rationale: Reliable constrained assets; player action directly edits beautiful lighting and kills.

concepts.medium: Low-poly Blender GLBs with orthographic bake and full 3D lights.
concepts.composition: Three-quarter view of a tiny lantern tower on a hill.
concepts.interaction: Swipe perspective and slot physical barriers.
concepts.motion: Articulated door gates and heavy stones.
concepts.rationale: Strong visual potential but significantly higher modeling/QA risk for phone sessions.

concepts.medium: Large etched monochrome vector prints and painterly hatching.
concepts.composition: Two-pane manuscript page and circular unit-command wheel.
concepts.interaction: Issue orders to four stone sentries.
concepts.motion: Animated ink crossings and delayed orders.
concepts.rationale: Excellent editorial look but more UI decisions and less immediate one-thumb feedback.

selection.reason: The moving light itself is gameplay and visual centerpiece; simple authorable silhouettes stay distinctive while physically meaningful light does the expensive work.

rejected.reason: Full 3D character and scene complexity would dominate this small project.
Orders and split UI compete with direct spotlight interaction.

tools.reason: Repository defines a Pillow-driven indexed-pixel v2 adapter and output validation; generated assets tracked by index.
Repository vector adapter exports safe SVG with Inkscape; original emblem is editable and also used in PWA.
Native browser Canvas2D composes atlas layers, beam penumbra, environment and effects.
Native WebAudio with user-gesture activation and explicit mute.

assets.role: Player lamp, five enemy types, 12 indexed frames with consistent pivots.
assets.acceptance: Frames 32x32, transparent, readable at 28-57px and nearest-neighbor; no fractional/painterly pixels.
assets.integration: Game sprite() draws indexed atlas and regenerates exact source in a safe fallback.
assets.provenance: Original authored indexed silhouettes, no third-party assets.

assets.role: Engraved lamp insignia and companion PWA artwork.
assets.acceptance: Shield and flame remain distinct at 48px.
assets.integration: SVG icon for PWA, Forge PNG for portable authored asset library.
assets.provenance: Original geometric SVG, no third-party artwork.

risks: WebKit full-screen safe area and stage controls
Generated atlas and index must remain fresh
Beam clarity against low-contrast enemies at small phone size
Paused/resumed run must not corrupt upgrades
Offline replay requires versioned isolated cache
